Title: EVT-OP-037: Characterizing convolution-equivalent laws: Foss–Korshunov Conjecture 1
Labels: open-problem, area:heavy-tails, type:research, difficulty:hard, status:research

**Status in the survey:** OPEN-EXPLICIT in 2007; no resolution found.

## Source and quote
Foss and Korshunov, Ann. Probab. 35 (2007), arXiv:math/0510273:

> For γ > 0 we have neither a proof of the conjecture nor a counterexample.

The quote was extracted from the source text, with symbols flattened; check it against the published version before citing.

## Why it matters
It would give a one-line test for convolution equivalence, used in ruin asymptotics with exponential moments.

## What the library already has
`IsSubexponential` and convolution roots (`HeavyTails/ConvolutionRoots.lean`). No `𝒮(γ)`.

## What is missing
The class `𝒮(γ)` and either a delicate counterexample or a proof.
